nodes.title: 制作输出 · 3×3 九机位矩阵

metadata.prompt: Produce a single image laid out as a 3x3 grid of nine equally sized cells. Cells must share their edges directly and fill the whole canvas edge to edge: no gutters, no separator lines, no padding, no outer margin or border around the grid. Each cell re-renders the supplied image from a different camera position and shot size: front eye-level medium, three-quarter left, three-quarter right, profile side, back view, high angle looking down, low angle looking up, wide establishing shot, and close-up detail. Preserve the exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, materials, color grading and art style of the supplied image. Keep lighting, scene and continuity identical across all nine cells; only the camera moves. Keep perspective and occlusion physically coherent in every cell. Do not add text, captions, watermarks, logos or frame borders.

metadata.content:
模板说明：3×3 九机位矩阵
请先在“上传原图”节点导入对应原始图片，再使用“制作输出”节点。
这是可复制的原生制作模板，不是已生成的成片案例；当前图片状态为未生成，也没有封面、模型、渠道或费用配置。
原始比例：16:9（已写入输出节点 size）
来源文件：03_画板视觉矩阵提示词/原生画板12组视觉矩阵提示词源码.md
来源 SHA256：f68de06d35341ee3c4460e29e14ac41e43318653fa6b33c8b371d21c3e2edba2
原始片段（仅作可追溯内容，不执行）：
```javascript
{
  scene: "multi-camera-grid-9",
  ratio: "16:9",
  prompt: [
    "Produce a single image laid out as a 3x3 grid of nine equally sized cells.",
    nv,
    "Each cell re-renders the supplied image from a different camera position and shot size: front eye-level medium, three-quarter left, three-quarter right, profile side, back view, high angle looking down, low angle looking up, wide establishing shot, and close-up detail.",
    qa,
    "Keep lighting, scene and continuity identical across all nine cells; only the camera moves. Keep perspective and occlusion physically coherent in every cell.",
    Xa
  ].join(" ")
}
```
